name: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku o! -Kono Yokubukai Game ni Shinpan o!-
original_name: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！ -この欲深いゲームに審判を！-
source:
A game adaptation based on web and light novel written by Akatsuki Natsume and illustrated Mishima Kurone. The series follows a boy who is sent to a fantasy world following his death, forming a dysfunctional party with a goddess, a wizard, and a crusader to fight against monsters.

[Edited from Wikipedia]
translation:
根据夏目晓所著、三岛黑音插画的网络小说和轻小说改编的游戏。该剧讲述了一个男孩死后被送到一个奇幻世界，与女神、巫师和十字军组成一个功能失调的队伍来对抗怪物的故事。

[编辑自维基百科]
